==Ingredients==

=== Dough ===
* 1 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] strong bread [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 21 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] dried [[Cookbook:Yeast|yeast]]
* 650 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] tepid water
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] salt
* 35 g [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]

=== Chocolate banana filling ===
* [[Cookbook:Nutella|Nutella]] or other chocolate spread
* 3–4 [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]], cut in 1-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick slices
* Chopped [[Cookbook:Nuts and Seeds|nuts]] (e.g. [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]], [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]], [[Cookbook:Pecan|pecans]])
* [[Cookbook:Chocolate Chips|Chocolate chips]] (optional)

==Procedure==

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] 180°C. 
# Mix all the dry ingredients together, add the water, and mix well with your hands.
# Work into a large pliable ball. Cut in half. 
# [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll]] the first half of the ball out on a floured board, to about ½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick, 12–15 inches wide, and as long as you can get it within those dimensions. 
# Spread nutella thickly and evenly down and across the dough, leaving an inch or so free on all sides. 
# Cover the chocolate spread with the banana slices. Sprinkle with chopped nuts and chocolate chips if desired. 
# Take one of the long sides of the dough and roll it inwards, forming a spiral log. Make sure the filling stays "tucked in". 
# Arrange the bread on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking tray]], either laid out straight or curled around on itself, whichever you prefer. 
# [[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] lightly with olive oil. Sprinkle with more chopped nuts if desired. Leave loaf aside in warm place to [[Cookbook:Proofing|proof]] for 30 minutes. 
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 30–35 minutes in the preheated 180°C oven. 
# Use the second half of the dough to make either a second sweet bread or a savory bread (see variation below). Fill and bake as above. 

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* To make a savory filling, use ingredients like bacon, egg, cheese, caramelized onion, etc.
